summary.zh: 祥旭门是毓庆宫建筑序列中的一座门。故宫出版物的具名平面将其标在前星门之后、惇本殿院前；独立题名的正面照片可见黄琉璃门顶、绿色框饰、两侧装饰面板、红色双扇门和浅色石基。这里的介绍与前星门、惇本殿分别对应，不把它们合为一个景点。
summary.en: Xiangxu Gate is part of the architectural sequence of Yuqing Palace. A named plan in a Palace Museum publication places it after Qianxing Gate and before the Dunben Hall courtyard. A separately captioned front photograph shows a yellow glazed top, green framing, ornamental panels on both sides, red double doors and pale stone feet. This entry is distinct from Qianxing Gate and Dunben Hall.

evidenceNote.zh: 依据已保存的故宫出版物页图核对名称、建筑顺序与正面可见构件；本轮没有重新访问完整官网页面。照片日期、精确尺度、背面和细部花纹未核实。英文名称与介绍均为项目译文，尚未核到本门的官方英文名。
evidenceNote.en: The identity, sequence and visible front features were checked against saved page images from Palace Museum publications, without a new visit to the complete web pages. The photograph date, exact dimensions, rear elevation and fine ornament remain unverified. The English name and description are project translations; an official English name for this gate has not been verified.

modelNote.zh: 模型仅作独立门面、关闭双扇与自有短墙翼的有限拟合，不接通旧院墙，不代表完整第二进院落。游戏坐标、尺寸、背面与简化装饰不是实测复原；本目录卡仅供介绍，没有新增地图点或传送目标。
modelNote.en: The model is a limited fit of an independent gate front, closed double doors and its own short walls. It does not connect existing courtyard walls or reconstruct the complete second courtyard. Game coordinates, dimensions, rear surfaces and simplified ornament are not a measured reconstruction. This information-only card adds no map marker or travel target.
